messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod-vpc tessera-prod — elevated 5xx rate for tenant `tessera` in dedicated pool `tessera-pool-2`. 5m error rate jumped to 12% (baseline ~0.3%). Sources: inference-runtime / health-checks. Paging on-call.

mira (SRE): @raj you are primary oncall for infra — can you take? :rotating_light:

raj (oncall): I'm on. starting investigation now. grabbing logs, traces, and the rollout history for tessera-pool-2.

mira (SRE): thanks. quick note: we had a micro-deploy (artifact id: a1b2c3-20260315) to a single slice this morning for staged traffic. suspecting that slice.

raj (oncall): initial tails: increased 5xx come from nodes in `slice-a`. Request IDs show `runtime:oom` and `kv-cache miss thrash`. latency spikes at ~08:12 UTC which matches deploy time.

dmitri (Runtime Eng): I see the stack dumps for failed requests — OOM in the attention kernel on quantized model path. The new artifact included an experimental kernel change. Not present on stable.

nina (Eng-Platform): routing shows route weights: slice-a 40%, slice-b 60%. Canary was intentional. We can immediately scale slice-a weight -> 0 via rollout API if you want to pull back traffic.

leah (Support): Geoff from Tessera is on the phone. Their customer-facing page shows timeouts and a few SLO alerts. They want an ETA. :telephone_receiver:

geoff (CS): Tessera PM: "Are we isolated to our VPC? Will my users see data migration?" They need us to contain blast radius and restore service for their webinar at 14:00.

raj (oncall): Plan suggestion: 1) Divert traffic off slice-a (set weight=0) 2) Re-pin to previous artifact (a1b2c3 -> stable hash d4e5f6) for pool tessera-pool-2 3) Quarantine slice-a nodes for postmortem. Anyone object?

mira (SRE): +1. Also enable tenant isolation to ensure no cross-tenant impact in case of resource leak. Add autoscaler lock so new canaries don't spin up.

dmitri (Runtime Eng): I can push a rollback artifact to the dedicated pool if we pin. Alternatively I can hot-patch the runtime, but pinning is faster and safer.

nina (Eng-Platform): Executing rollout API now:
```bash
# divert slice-a -> 0
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane/api/v1/rollouts/tessera-pool-2/actions -d '{"slice":"slice-a","weight":0}'
```
Response: 200 OK — weight update queued.

incident-bot: action: rollout-weight-change queued by nina at 08:21:12 UTC. Watch: https://console/internal/rollouts/tessera-pool-2

raj (oncall): Confirming traffic cutover: slice-a 0% within 30s, error rate dropping from 12% -> 1.1% in first 2 minutes. Good sign.

leah (Support): Letting Tessera know we diverted canary traffic and are pinning to stable. Geoff — sending update to PM now.

geoff (CS): Sent: "We diverted the problematic slice and restored traffic to the stable artifact. Monitoring closely. Will confirm when fully green." They want a short blameless summary for executives.

dmitri (Runtime Eng): Initiating pin to stable artifact now. Command to control plane:
```json
{"action":"pin","pool":"tessera-pool-2","artifact_hash":"d4e5f6","reason":"emergency rollback - runtime OOM"}
```

incident-bot: action: pin-request accepted, starting pinned rollout. Estimated completion 120s.

nina (Eng-Platform): Pin rollout completed at 08:24:10 UTC. Pool tessera-pool-2 now running artifact d4e5f6. slice-a remains isolated for diagnostics.

raj (oncall): Metrics now: 5xx down to 0.4% over 5m, p95 latency back to baseline. No other tenants impacted. Verified KV cache behavior normalized.

mira (SRE): Great. Next steps: preserve slice-a instance logs and heap dumps, mark nodes as quarantined, schedule forensic run by Runtime Eng. Will open postmortem ticket and link to this thread.

dmitri (Runtime Eng): Saving dumps and uploading to secure bucket. Preliminary note: experimental kernel increased memory footprints under specific sequence lengths + quantization pattern. I will PR revert and run perf suite.

geoff (CS): Tessera PM says: "Thanks, appreciate the fast response. Please follow up with root-cause and mitigation so we can update customers." Will coordinate on customer comms. :white_check_mark:

leah (Support): I created incident ticket INC-20260315-42 and added impacted customer tags + webinar escalation. I also scheduled a 09:30 postmortem sync with Tessera ops.

mira (SRE): Handoff: I'm sticky on this for the next hour to watch for secondary issues. @raj can you follow up with daily rotation? If we see any regression I'll page.

raj (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll create the RCA draft and assign to dmitri + platform. Thanks team.

incident-bot: incident resolved: containment achieved — traffic reverted and artifact pinned. Severity: Sev2. Auto-close timer set for 8h if no regression.

mira (SRE): closing notes: no cross-tenant impact, dedicated pool isolation worked as expected, pinned rollback was fastest mitigation. Postmortem to include: better canary heuristics (limit slice weight to 5%), rollout automation safeguards, and automated preflight memory checks for experimental kernels.

nina (Eng-Platform): Linking runbooks: https://wiki/runbooks/rollbacks , added a note to temporary disable canary weight >10% for dedicated pools until kernel tests pass.

geoff (CS): Tessera confirmed stable at 08:40 UTC. They will await the formal RCA before customer bulletin.

leah (Support): Closing the customer-facing incident update. I'll keep watch on Slack but moving to monitoring state. :mag:

mira (SRE): Thanks all. Postmortem assigned to dmitri (lead) and nina (platform) — target draft in 24h. If anything new shows up re-open thread.

raj (oncall): Logging handoff: Oncall-night will monitor until 02:00 UTC; next oncall morning team take at 06:00 UTC. All good for now. :thumbsup:
